conventions.incumbent_flag: Candidate currently holds the office being contested (Senate/governor) or currently serves in the U.S. House in any district (House; see incumbent_of when the member was redistricted into a different district number).
conventions.house_incumbent_field: House race.incumbent is the member currently representing that district NUMBER per unitedstates/congress-legislators (pre-2026-map numbering). In redistricted states (redistricted_2026=true) the 2026 district boundaries differ; wiki_incumbent_2026_map lists the member(s) Wikipedia treats as incumbent under the new map.
conventions.poll_close_et: Last statewide poll close in U.S. Eastern Time (EST, UTC-5). 00:00 and 01:00 mean Nov 4 ET (Hawaii, Alaska). See poll_close.json for notes and UTC.
conventions.baseline_2022: Same office in 2022 when available; otherwise another statewide race, with office/year/note set explicitly (DE: 2022 House at-large; MS: 2023 GOV; MT: 2024 SEN; NJ/VA: 2021 GOV; WV: 2024 SEN).
